mainEntity.name: What does an AI-assisted paid newsletter workflow actually look like from idea to publication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin with a narrow workflow instead of trying to automate research, writing, sales, support, and analytics at once. A practical sequence is topic intake, source collection, outline, draft, fact review, editing, approval, publication, and post-publication repurposing. Run My AI Biz recommends building one assistant, using it, refining it, and expanding only after the process works. Define the inputs each step needs, the output format, the person responsible for review, and the conditions that stop automation. A chief-of-staff-style assistant may later coordinate specialized tasks, but it should not obscure who approves the final issue. This approach lowers setup complexity and makes failures easier to diagnose.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a sequence such as topic intake, source collection, outline, draft, fact review, editing, approval, publication, and repurposing. Start with one assistant and explicit review points; expand only after the basic workflow produces reliable issues.
